paragraphs.text: Talibah (tah-lee-bah ) of Emberwilde is an embermage from Dominaria .

She was a member of the Mages of the Emberwilde Order , a group of Suq'Ata mages who pledged their allegiance to the djinn and efreet of Wildfire . Talibah is a thug with power. However, her tone becomes very enlightened and "less aggressive" when referring to Wildfire.

Wildfire was instrumental in defending Suq’Ata against Kaervek during the Mirage Wars when it commanded its sorcerers, djinn, efreets, and spirits against the dark legions. Indeed, as the Suq’Ata shrank into their empire, it was the power of the Emberwilde that helped maintain their closed border.
